verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing-page dialogue in which a user says their data lives in spreadsheets and the reply promises to "map it during onboarding" with a migration checklist. The SDK docs also note that developer-built object actions can be used for "imports". Nothing documents a native spreadsheet/CSV import with column-to-field mapping, validation, or row-level error reporting. Missing for 10: a documented native CSV/spreadsheet importer, field-mapping UI, validation rules, reporting of skipped or failed rows (no silent loss), deal import specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
